customer_request: Replace the casework triage spreadsheets with an AI queue so the backlog falls by 40 per cent this quarter.
stated_outcome: Help eligible applicants receive a clear, timely case decision while preserving accountable public-service decisions, accessible channels and records controls.
known_facts: All records, people, organisations and measurements in this repository are synthetic.
The sponsor may authorise discovery but cannot approve policy, privacy, records, accessibility or production AI decisions.
The service currently uses a web form, shared mailbox, spreadsheet queue and a separate records system.
The baseline pack reports 1,240 open cases and a median age of 18 business days, but the extraction method has not been independently validated.
Approximately 14 per cent of contacts in the synthetic sample are repeat status enquiries.
A non-digital assisted channel must remain available.
visible_tensions: The sponsor frames AI as the solution before the user need and failure demand are understood.
Caseworkers report duplicate entry; security describes the same step as an important control.
The contact centre measures call duration while service operations values first-contact resolution.
Procurement wants an indicative cost range before the current unit cost is agreed.
Accessibility needs are described as edge cases in one meeting note.
authorised_scope: Interview and observe fictional personas supplied in the repository.
Analyse generated workflow and measurement fixtures.
Create a synthetic discovery dossier, value hypothesis and traceable backlog.
Run local validation, evidence sealing and controlled changed-constraint exercises.
excluded_scope: No contact with real service users or Meridian staff.
No external system, provider, customer data, account or production environment.
No determination of legal compliance, policy eligibility, records obligations or AI deployment approval.
No claim that a prototype, metric or synthetic interview proves production impact.
starting_assumptions: The backlog count represents unique active cases.
Reducing triage time will reduce end-to-end case age.
Applicants primarily want a faster decision rather than clearer status information.
An AI classifier would be more valuable than workflow and data-quality changes.
learner_note: Treat the request, figures and stakeholder statements as discovery inputs, not truth. An assessor may issue one controlled changed constraint during the exit exercise.
